topics.title: Retail sales associate interview
topics.description: Practice a simple first interview for an entry-level retail sales job.

topics.objective: Answer simple questions about availability, experience, and customer service confidently.
topics.opening_message: Hi there, thanks for coming in today! Can you tell me a little about yourself?
topics.instructions: Ask simple, clear questions one at a time. Wait for the candidate's answer before moving on, and keep a friendly, encouraging tone.
topics.vocabulary_focus: available, shift, customer service, teamwork, experience

topics.title: Fast food crew member interview
topics.description: Practice answering basic questions for a fast food or cafe crew job.

topics.instructions: Keep questions short and concrete. Ask about food safety, speed, and teamwork basics, one topic at a time.
topics.vocabulary_focus: shift, punctual, food safety, teamwork, fast-paced

topics.title: Warehouse associate interview
topics.description: Practice a basic interview for a warehouse picker or packer role.
topics.situation: You are applying for a warehouse associate job that involves lifting and using a scanner.

topics.opening_message: Good morning, thanks for coming in. Can you tell me about any warehouse or lifting experience you have?
topics.instructions: Ask practical questions about safety, lifting, and shift work. Keep language simple and direct.
topics.vocabulary_focus: forklift, inventory, safety boots, shift, scanner

topics.instructions: Ask simple, practical questions about the license, routes, and punctuality. Keep the pace relaxed.
topics.vocabulary_focus: driver's license, route, delivery, punctual, package

topics.vocabulary_focus: efficiency, KPI, process improvement, budget management, cross-functional

topics.title: Sales director interview
topics.description: Practice a senior interview for a sales director leadership position.
topics.situation: You are applying for a sales director role leading a regional sales team.
topics.objective: Show strategic sales leadership and team development skills.
topics.opening_message: Thanks for coming in today. Can you tell me about your strategy for growing a sales team's performance?
topics.instructions: Ask about sales strategy, coaching underperforming reps, and forecasting. Probe for data-driven leadership examples.
topics.vocabulary_focus: pipeline, forecast, quota attainment, sales culture, coaching

topics.title: Chief technology officer executive interview
topics.description: Practice an executive-level interview for a CTO position at a growing company.
topics.situation: You are interviewing for the chief technology officer role at a scaling startup.
topics.objective: Demonstrate executive technical vision and leadership at the highest level.
topics.opening_message: Thank you for joining us. Let's begin: what is your philosophy on building and scaling an engineering organization?
topics.instructions: Simulate an executive-level conversation with challenging strategic questions about scaling, hiring, and technical vision. Push for depth and trade-offs.
topics.vocabulary_focus: technical vision, scalability, talent retention, technical debt, board communication

topics.title: Non-profit executive director interview
topics.description: Practice a senior leadership interview for an executive director role at a non-profit.
topics.situation: You are interviewing with the board for the executive director position at a non-profit organization.
topics.objective: Show strategic leadership, fundraising vision, and mission alignment.
topics.opening_message: Thank you for being here. The board would like to start by asking about your vision for the organization's next five years.
topics.instructions: Simulate a board interview with questions on fundraising strategy, stakeholder relations, and mission impact. Probe for vision and accountability.
topics.vocabulary_focus: fundraising strategy, donor relations, mission impact, stakeholder, organizational culture

topics.title: Plant manager executive interview
topics.description: Practice a senior interview for a plant manager overseeing a large manufacturing facility.
topics.situation: You are interviewing for a plant manager role overseeing a large manufacturing facility with several hundred employees.
topics.objective: Show strategic operational leadership and safety-first culture building.
topics.opening_message: Thanks for coming in. Can you describe how you would build a strong safety culture while also hitting production targets?
topics.instructions: Ask about safety culture, labour relations, and balancing cost with quality. Probe for specific leadership trade-offs.
topics.vocabulary_focus: safety culture, labour relations, throughput, incident management, leadership pipeline
